notes: data.prices.SSE.dividend_source: no cited SSE Composite dividend yield was found (SSE and CSIndex sources searched), so the SSE sleeve earns the index price return without dividends; this understates SSE total returns of invested days and is a limitation (SPEC §2.1 fallback).
ltsf.*: mean (and standard deviation) over seeds 0-2 of the test MSE and MAE on standardised data, all channels, every test window; no reversible instance normalisation (not part of SPEC §15).
data.news.market.*: means and shares over trading days 2010-01-01 .. 2025-12-31 (policy start to the end of the news date range); by-year shares cover every panel year.
sentiflow.pooled: union of the test splits of phrasebank50, fiqa and twitter (phrasebank_all is a subset of phrasebank50 and is not counted twice).

sentiflow.<DS>.SF: calibrated SentiFlow; A, A_REV and B are the raw branches (their calibration is in sentiflow.calibration_b for B). sentiflow.calibration.temperature is the mean of the five per-seed temperatures.
sentiflow.scoring.ensemble: five-seed scoring would exceed 12 h, so seed 0 alone scored the corpus (SPEC §3.8).
e13.*: means (and sd) over seeds 0-2 for neural models; SVM deterministic; MM_DIR CAUSAL only. n_train counts the training and early-stopping samples (80 % of the samples).

marketmind.h*: metrics pooled over the four markets and the test years 2020-2024, averaged over seeds 0-2 (pinball_sd = standard deviation over seeds); pt_p is the median over seeds; NAIVE, EWMA and HAR are deterministic. marketmind.dm: MM minus model on the daily cross-market average of the seed-averaged pinball loss (HLN-corrected DM, Newey-West lag h-1); a negative stat favours MarketMind.
e13x: leakage decomposition pre-registered on 2026-10-21 before the G4 lock (scripts/p3_e13x.py); X_NEWS_LEAD is a diagnostic with a deliberate one-session news look-ahead, not a method.
dev.diagnostic.checkpoint: pre-lock diagnostic of checkpoint-selection bias on development data (scripts/p4_ckpt_diagnostic.py); its variants are logged in dev_trials.jsonl and counted in DSR/PBO.

trading.COMBINED: equal-weight daily portfolio of the four sleeves (0 on a market's holidays); turnover = mean of the sleeves' turnovers; win_rate on days with positive average sleeve exposure. Each test year starts at e = 1 (folds).
robust.regime: the return of day t carries the regime known at the close of t−1 (trailing 126-day index return).
h6.stability.flip_rate: share of days whose Buy/Hold/Sell label differs from the previous day's label.

h5: placebo exposure paths are reflecting random walks on [0, 1] from e = 1 with Gaussian steps whose size is set so that the mean |Δe| after the band equals the PPO ensemble's (per market-year); p = share of placebo Sharpe ≥ PPO Sharpe over 2020-2024.

e13.overlap: SMARTRL and BASE score = exposure decided at the close of t (prediction 1[e_t > 0.5]); SENTIN_CAUSAL = seed-averaged P(up) of the E13 CAUSAL test predictions; window 2020-01-01 .. 2022-03-31.

compute: wall-clock hours of registry run records by device (status ok, plus three P5 SAC stages stopped from outside - two user pauses and a desktop-app update - closed by scripts/p5_register_interrupted.py with end = save time of their last policy; they saved 37 of the 72 B7 policies). compute.n_runs counts run records (a P5 training stage is one record although it trains many policies: 660 PPO-arm policies and 72 SAC policies in P5).

trading.*.A4_NOCONF: identical to SMARTRL by construction. A4 is AWS with beta = 1 (no confidence term, SPEC ablation table) and the development-phase selection (P4, dev.selected) chose beta = 1.0 for the full system, so the selected SMART-RL already gives the confidence term zero weight; tests.lw.A4_NOCONF (diff 0) confirms the identity.

h2.coverage.<grp>.n: pooled test days with news coverage cov >= 0.5 (high) or < 0.5 (low); h2.coverage.<grp>.mcnemar_p_exploratory: exact McNemar test of SMART-RL versus A1 decision correctness within the group, added after P5 as an exploratory statistic (not pre-registered, not used by any verdict).

diag.*: post-hoc descriptive diagnostics computed after P5 by scripts/p5_diagnostics.py to explain notable results (delay effect, news coverage, SenT-In output, BASE exposure); not pre-registered and not used by any verdict.

e14.data.*: calendar rows 2005-01-01..2022-03-31 (the last date only provides the next close); NIFTY 50 before 2007-09-17 from NSE Indices (niftyindices.com), Yahoo from 2007-09-17; nifty_splice_maxdiff = max relative close difference on the first 20 common days.
e14.causal.zero_change: trading-day samples of 2005-01-01..2022-03-31 with C_{t+1} = C_t (the only rows where labels GE and GT differ under CAUSAL).
e14.news: headline counts per UTC year of the multisource corpus (P1 rules; 2005-2006 extracted in P6 with the same code), local = the market's tag, global = every kept headline.

e14.a_paper: the base paper's GRU-CNN sentiment classifier trained with its Table 2 recipe (400 epochs, lr 0.01, Adam, batch 64, dropout 0.1, pool 2, no early stopping), mean and sd over seeds 0-2 on the SPEC §2.4 test splits.

e14.<SET>.<MKT>.<MODEL>: test metrics, mean (and sd) over seeds 0-2 (SVM deterministic); .inf = the same metrics on the informative_row test rows (the next calendar date is a session). Thresholds: P(up) > 0.5; SVM decision > 0; MM_DIR q50 >= 0 (GE) or > 0 (GT). MM_DIR in the GT settings is its GE fit scored against the GT labels (protocol run matrix).
e14.labels: always-positive rule on the PUB test rows (diagnostic, no training).
